scope: Exact Cauchy-Binet and integer Gram identities; integer/real image and primitive-basis transfer under an integer left inverse; literal map determinants 3, 9, 8; covolume squared equals the Gram determinant of an actual integer-lattice basis; positive Gram determinant of an integer 6-by-4 matrix with nonzero rows distinct up to sign is at least six. Construct the full integer-point lattice of every rational coordinate subspace and derive squared covolume at least one, or at least six in rank four with a contained nonzero sign-distinct integer vector. Derive the original constants 9075, 54450, and 163350 for actual primitive six-speed norms relative to this covolume, retaining the explicit four-speed runner-bound and containing-plane-gap hypotheses. No unconditional plane-gap, runner-bound, or spectrum-classification theorem is asserted. Also prove the squared covolume is at most the integer Gram determinant of every full independent integer column basis, by an actual integer coordinate-change determinant.
